data.label: include
data.reason_zh: 提出SpecRSI：以验证为门控生成可执行后继智能体，用树搜索分配预算，并从已完成搜索中学习改进器，构成多轮自改进方法。

scope_support.feedback_quote: Verification-Aware Tree Search (VATS) allocates the budget between further edits and outstanding checks using the predicted verified return of a continuation.
scope_support.object_quote: which drafts executable successor agents before their predecessors are fully evaluated, while requiring complete verification before adoption
scope_support.persistence_quote: Group Verification Optimization (GVO) learns the improver from completed searches while keeping the real evaluator fixed.
